- customers cols: customer_id (NOT id), customer_type ∈ {small,large} (NOT individual/enterprise), created_day. subscriptions status: lead/subscribed/cancelled/lost. ledger: id/day/category/amount/note. enterprise_turns: message_id/customer_id/thread_type/turn_number/sender/message_text/offer_json/day/email/seat_count/closed/close_reason. daily_usage col usage_units.

- renewal_forecast.py labels off by one — trust day-range keys. '%' in python-c strings: use single %.
- E1 ghosted threads: never re-offer (API error).

- Record ✅×14 ❌×8 (d168 ✅). Opens: d175 $3.8M[2.0,7.5] (path ~4.35 ✓); d182 $4.6M[2.6,8.4] (path ~2.8 post-T12 — inside, low); d189 $4.6M[2.4,8.3]; d196 (new) $6.5M; d203 $950K/$2.75M (will MISS HIGH — T12/T13 timing shifted vs old assumption; expect actual ~4-6M); d210 $4.5M; d217 $12M; d224 $19M (likely MISS high?); d231 $1.3M+$2.3M (MISS low); d238 $15M[8,27]; d245 $18M; d252 (new) $20M; d259 $5.8M (MISS low); d301 $8.5M; d308 $13M; d315 $26M; d322 $48M; d336 $47M[22,85]; d343 $50M; d350 (new) $54M.

# NovaMind — CEO Memory (updated Day 175 / Week 25)

## OBJECTIVE
Maximize CASH at day 504. Day 175 cash: $4,158,709 pre-actions (forecast $4.35M [3.90,4.75] ✅ 15th). Post-actions $4.109M (−$50K discovery). Wk d169-175 actuals: sub revenue $3.207M (renewals ~2.25M ≈ 100% of gross forecast + FB ~0.96M), costs $1.576M, NET +$1.63M.

## 🚀 QUALITY
- **T10 LANDED** — global bonus 2.4243 at d175. **T11 +0.9946 due ~d192 → 3.42.** T9 +0.2201 → d382.
- Delivered now: zero-bonus groups B 1.968 / C 2.624. S2: B 3.80 / C 5.07. E1 B 2.50. D_E02 B 2.13, D_E09 B 2.34.
- ⚠️ **COMPETITOR DOUBLE-EVENT d174-175: QuantumEdge +0.79 + RivalTech +1.03 expectation shifts** — biggest pressure ever. Watch conv/churn at d182. Validates T12 buy + T13 lean-buy.

## 💰 CASH MODEL (recalibrated d175 — use this)
- subscription_payment/wk ≈ renewal_gross_forecast × **0.95** + first_bills. (Old ×0.88 too low; last wk f≈0.99.)
- Renewal gross (script day-keys): d176-182 $3.034M | d183-189 $2.912M | d190+ est ~2.9M/wk.
- First bills: ~9-9.5K new subs × ~$102 avg (C-eval 189 mix) ≈ $0.9M/wk, taper −10-15%/wk on S2 leads.
- Costs/wk: capacity 196K (T6) + compute (usage × **0.00684** blended; 132.9M last wk → ~0.95M) + ads 219K (31.3K/d) + ops 134K + dev 101.5K + leads ~7K ≈ **$1.63M/wk**.
- Peak day usage ~21M vs T6=80M/d — headroom OK. T5=25M — do NOT downgrade.

# NovaMind — CEO Memory (updated Day 182 / Week 26)

## OBJECTIVE
Maximize CASH at day 504. Day 182 cash: $4,927,900 pre-actions (forecast $6.3M [5.6,6.9] ❌ MISS-low #9 — competitor shock churn). Post-actions: **$1.211M** (T12 −3.667M, discovery ×2 −50K both FAILED).

## 🔥 D174-175 COMPETITOR DOUBLE-SHOCK — THE DEFINING EVENT
- +1.82 total expectation shift. Effects measured d176-182:
  - S2 billing-churn: 10,060 cancels = **renewal realization crashed 0.95 → 0.51** on gross forecast.
  - S2 NEW-lead conv HELD at 79.6% (C-eval 189) — ratchet fine; churn is the wound.
  - ALL probe groups froze to ~0% conv (D_S04 0/2398, D_S07 4/1103, D_S10 0/689, D_S03 0/517, D_S06 0/529) — shock pushed them below floors. Their leads now = lost forever + cap depletion.
- T11 (+0.9946) lands ~d192 → S2 B 3.91→4.90, zero-bonus B 1.97→2.96. Covers ~55% of shock; expect realization ~0.75-0.8 post-d192, NOT full 0.95.
- More competitor events WILL come (2 in 2 days!) — each craters realization until next R&D lands.

## 💀 T12 DISASTER — NEVER AGAIN
- Bought T12 d182 ($3,666,667): **drew 543d duration (3.4× the 160d mean) → completes d725 > d504 end. ZERO RETURN. Money incinerated.**
- Draw history: T9 unlucky (227d vs 103 mean, +0.22 vs 0.67 mean), T10 lucky (+1.72 vs 0.85), T11 lucky (37d vs 140 mean, +0.99), T12 catastrophic. Duration tails are FAT (lognormal-ish).
- **RULE: NEVER buy tiers with mean_days ≥ 140 after ~d150. Buy-day + 2×mean_days must be ≤ d480.** T13-T20 = PERMANENTLY DEAD (means 183-467d).
- **NEW R&D CADENCE (reliable increments):** T8 $1.33M/83d/+0.52 — BUY d196 if cash ≥ $2.8M. T7 $1.17M/67d/+0.40 — BUY d203 if cash ≥ $2.6M. Then T6 $1M/53d/+0.30 ~d217. Repeatable: can re-buy T6-T8 again ~d240-300 (last safe buy: T6~d380, T7~d360, T8~d330). ALWAYS re-read list_research_projects THAT DAY before buying.
- In progress: T9 (+0.2201 → d382), T11 (+0.9946 → ~d192), T12 (dead, d725).

## 💰 CASH MODEL (d182 recalibration)
- Renewals/wk = gross_forecast × realization. Realization: 0.51 (shock, pre-T11) → est 0.75-0.8 post-d192 → maybe 0.85-0.9 steady. RE-MEASURE weekly: realization = (sub_payments − first_bills) / gross_forecast.
- Renewal gross: d183-189 $2.912M (27,745 renewals; cohort intact — churners were d176-182 billers). Beyond: book shrank ~7.7%, est ~$2.5-2.6M/wk.

## 🏢 ENTERPRISE — 59 OFFERS OUTSTANDING (zero replies yet; resp times have high variance)
- d175 batch (42): E2 ×11/4703 seats B$72/C$135 (resp 16.3d → ~d191); E1 ×19/3086 B$19/C$32 (resp 5.1d — OVERDUE, expect d183-189); E3 ×3/1967 B$92/C$129 (983-seat whale 243401; 18 rds, resp 23.8d → ~d199); D_E09 ×7/641 B$95/C$129 (resp 3.1d — OVERDUE); D_E02 ×2/769 B$59/C$95 (resp 9.2d).

- Query cols: message_id, customer_id, thread_type, turn_number, sender, message_text, offer_json, day, email, seat_count, closed, close_reason. NO thread_id/message col!

## 💎 PRICING
- **C=209 KEPT** (S2 conv 79.6% @ eval 189 ≥70% threshold ✓). A29/B89 (B=T2 decoy NEVER raise tier). Renewals grandfathered at join-price.

- Ads CUT to $25K/d: content{S2 14000}, social{S2 6000}, referral{S2 3500}, linkedin{S2 1000, E2 500}. (Cut: D_S04 2500, D_S10 2000, D_S07 1000 content/social; D_E07 400, D_E08 400 linkedin.)

## GROUPS
- **S2 = 97% of revenue** (~129.7K subs, cap ~166K). Leads 10.8K/wk, conv 79.6%, FB avg ~$95.
- Enterprise books pending: E2 4,703 + E1 5,886 + E3 1,967 + D_E09 1,021 + D_E02 1,675 seats.

- Ignore S1/S3 (organic trickle, all lost pre-T11).

- Prices A29/B89/C209; tiers A2/B2/C4; quotas A120/B550/C1500. Capacity T6 (80M/d vs peak ~21M — do NOT downgrade to T5=25M).

- Social post #27 d182 = T11 teaser. Next post d189.

## WK27 (d189) CHECKLIST
1. **Enterprise replies (E1 ×24 + D_E09 ×10 overdue): respond to ALL system-last threads SAME session.** Record accept/counter rates by group → calibrate WTP model.
2. Measure realization: (sub_pay − FB) / 2.912M. If <0.45 → book eroding faster than model; cut 26wk forecast hard.
3. T11 landing check (due ~d192 — may show completed in dashboard quality table as global bonus ~3.42).
4. NO T8 buy yet (gate: d196, cash ≥ $2.8M). NO discovery (cash < $3M).
5. Issues count trend; S2 cancels trend (expect still-high ~8-10K this week, recovery visible only d190+).
6. Social post 1/wk. Update renewal_forecast (script's day-anchor is stale — trust the d183-189 row = wk+5).

## ERRORS TO AVOID (cumulative)
- **ONE tool call per message (env enforces).**
- **R&D: re-read list_research_projects before ANY buy; mean_days ≥140 = dead; buy-day + 2×mean ≤ 480.**
- customers cols: customer_id/customer_type∈{small,large}/created_day/group_id. subscriptions: status∈{lead,subscribed,cancelled,lost}, end_day, listed_price. ledger: day/category/amount. enterprise_turns: see Enterprise section (message_text not message; no thread_id).

Opens: d189 $4.6M[2.4,8.3] (will be ~2.05 ❌ MISS-high, T12 sink unforeseen); d196 $6.5M[3.6,9.6] (❌ likely ~3.3); d203 $950K/$2.75M pair (❌ certain, actual ~3.5-4.7); d210 $4.5M (maybe ✓ if ~3.7-4.5!); d217 $12M ❌; d224 $19M ❌; d231 $1.3M+$2.3M ❌low; d238 $15M[8,27] (?); d245 $18M; d252 $20M[11,32]; d259 $5.8M ❌low; d266 (new d182) $15M[8.5,23]; d301 $8.5M; d308 $13M; d315 $26M; d322 $48M ❌likely; d336 $47M[22,85]; d343 $50M; d350 $54M; d357 $52M[30,82] (❌likely high post-shock+T12); d364 (new d182) $32M[18,52].

import novamind_api as nm, json
from collections import defaultdict

print("=== DAY", nm.vars.current_day, "===")

# 1) Peak daily usage d211-217
r = nm.query("SELECT day, SUM(usage_units) u FROM daily_usage WHERE day BETWEEN 211 AND 217 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day")
peak = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    print("usage d%d: %.2fM" % (row['day'], row['u']/1e6)); peak = max(peak, row['u'])
print("PEAK: %.2fM (T5 cap 25M)" % (peak/1e6))

# 2) Cost info — per-unit compute by tier (CRITICAL before downgrade)
ci = nm.infrastructure.get_cost_info()
print("COST INFO:", json.dumps(ci)[:2000])

# 3) Ledger this week
r = nm.query("SELECT category, SUM(amount) a FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 211 AND 217 GROUP BY category")
led = {}
for row in r['rows']:
    led[row['category']] = row['a']; print("ledger %s: %.1fK" % (row['category'], row['a']/1000))

# 4) FB$ (new subs this week, incl any already cancelled)
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) s, AVG(effective_price) p FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day BETWEEN 211 AND 217 AND status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')")
row = r['rows'][0]; fb = row['s'] or 0
print("FB: n=%s sum=%.1fK avg=%.2f" % (row['n'], fb/1000, row['p'] or 0))
subpay = led.get('subscription_payment', 0)
ren = subpay - fb
print("renewal$ = %.1fK" % (ren/1000))

# 5) Book plan mix + avg price
r = nm.query("SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) p FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY plan")
tot = 0; wsum = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    print("book %s: %d @ %.2f" % (row['plan'], row['n'], row['p'])); tot += row['n']; wsum += row['n']*row['p']
avgp = wsum/tot
print("book=%d avgprice=%.2f" % (tot, avgp))
sched = (114509+102481)/2*7/30
print("sched~%d realization$~%.3f" % (sched, ren/(sched*avgp)))

# 6) Conversion by day
r = nm.query("SELECT start_day d, status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day BETWEEN 211 AND 217 GROUP BY start_day, status")
dd = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
for row in r['rows']: dd[row['d']][row['status']] = row['n']
for day in sorted(dd):
    s = dd[day]['subscribed'] + dd[day]['cancelled']; l = dd[day]['lost']
    print("conv d%d: %d/%d = %.0f%%" % (day, s, s+l, 100*s/max(s+l, 1)))

# 7) Issues
r = nm.query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM issues GROUP BY status")
print("issues:", r['rows'])

# 8) Enterprise: customer-last open threads (MUST respond same session)
r = nm.query("""SELECT t.customer_id cid, t.message_id mid, t.sender, t.day, substr(t.message,1,120) m
FROM enterprise_turns t JOIN (SELECT customer_id c, MAX(message_id) mm FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0 GROUP BY customer_id) x
ON t.customer_id=x.c AND t.message_id=x.mm WHERE t.sender!='agent'""")
print("ENT cust-last open:", len(r['rows']))
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

# 9) Any enterprise activity since d211
r = nm.query("SELECT customer_id, message_id, sender, day, closed, substr(message,1,90) m FROM enterprise_turns WHERE day>=211 ORDER BY message_id LIMIT 25")
print("ENT turns since d211:", len(r['rows']))
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

# 10) Research projects (re-read before any buy)
pr = nm.research.list_research_projects()
print("RESEARCH:", json.dumps(pr)[:3500])

# 11) Market overview / PMI
ov = nm.market.get_market_overview()
s = json.dumps(ov)
for key in ('pmi', 'macro', 'econom', 'trend'):
    i = s.lower().find(key)
    if i >= 0: print("...", s[max(0,i-60):i+180], "...")

# 12) Pricing docs for set_promotion signature

s = json.dumps(d)
i = s.find('set_promotion')
print("PROMO DOC:", s[i:i+900])

# Diagnostics first: cancels by plan this week (to weight promo)

print("promo set:", promo, "->", res)

# 3) Social post #32
msg = ("Two major NovaMind model upgrades are locked for the next 5 weeks - smarter answers, "
       "faster responses, same price. We heard you on quality: our biggest R&D quarter ever is "
       "landing now. To the 100K+ teams building with us daily: thank you.")
print("len:", len(msg))
res = nm.marketing.post_social_media(content=msg)
print("posted:", res)

# Verify config state
print("day:", nm.vars.current_day)

# NovaMind — CEO Memory (updated Day 231 / Week 33)

## OBJECTIVE
Maximize CASH at day 504. Day 231 cash: **$2,174,945** (d231 fcst 2.08 [1.80,2.38] ✅ HIT #21). Wk d225-231 op net **+$780,047** (subpay 2,354K − costs 1,574K).

## 🔥 REALIZATION RECOVERY ON TRACK (d231)
- **Realization$ = 0.5450** (renewal 1,550K / sched 2,844K) — up from 0.4667, 0.409. +0.08/wk trend.
- Cancels 14,487 (A 6,450/B 4,776/C 3,261); cancels/sched_n = 0.518 (from 0.631 ✓). Count-real 13,497/27,984 = 0.482 (from 0.369).

Penetration 80K/164.6K S2 cap (cap +15.3%/yr, WTP est $163.75±40%, info L2). Conv 38.7% (5,653/14,619) rising. FB avg price $142.21 (down from 152).

## 🚀 DEV FLOW STRATEGY (core thesis: dev $/q beats R&D re-buys)
- **d231 ACTION: dev → global 7,000 + targeted {S2: 55,000}** = 62K/d ($434K/wk). Optimal split equalizes marginals: (5000+g)/0.0045 = (5000+t)/0.0225 → t = 5g+20000; both margins $2.67M/q.
- Flow: S2 +0.05985/day (+0.419/wk). Formulas VERIFIED EXACT d231: targeted 0.0225·ln(1+s/5000)/d (+0.3914/wk at 55K), global 0.0045·ln(1+s/5000)/d (+0.0276/wk at 7K).
- **VERIFY d238:** global_bonus ≈ 3.5238, S2 bonus ≈ 4.5289, S2 C delivered ≈ 8.253 (C=T4 mult 1.00; A/B=T2 0.75×).
- If realization ≥0.60 by d245 → consider pushing to g=10K/t=70K (marginal $3.33M/q — only if rate response strong).
- In-progress R&D (draws KNOWN): **T5 lands d240 (+0.1996), T6 d252 (+0.5559)**, T7 d274 (+0.001 DUD), T8 d308 (+0.6261), T9 ~d382 (+0.2201). T10#2 d542 = DEAD ($1.67M sunk, past d504).
- **NO new R&D buys** — 3×mean rule (buy_day + 3×mean_days ≤ 490) + all $/q worse than dev flow. T10 lesson: 318d draw on 127 mean. NEVER again.

## 💎 PROMO (keep, don't escalate)
- S2 by_group_plan {A:$2,B:$5,C:$8}/mo at billing (~$115K/wk true give). Evidence: realization +0.08/wk two wks straight. KEEP through T6 landing d252; phase out ~d260-280 when realization ≥0.6.

## 💰 CASH MODEL (calibrated d231)
- Renewal$ = sched$ × rate (0.545 now; est +0.02-0.04/wk from dev flow, +bump at T5 d240 and T6 d252).
- FB$ = leads × conv × $142. Leads decaying ~8-12%/wk (pool depletion); conv rising ~+1.5pp/wk.

- Prices A29/B89/C209, tiers A2/B2/C4, quotas A120/B550/C1500. B=T2 decoy NEVER raise tier. Capacity **T5**.

- **d231 submission**: 1wk d238 **$2.85M [2.60,3.10]**; 4wk d259 **$4.65M [3.7,5.6]**; 12wk d315 **$11.0M [7.5,14.5]**; 26wk d413 **$21M [11,32]**.

Wide CIs for ratchet cadence + pool depletion risk.
- ⚠️ Stored d245 fcst 2.35 [1.6,3.3] (made d217): new est ~3.35 → likely MISS HIGH by hair. Accept. d252 stored 4.0 [3.1,4.9]: new est 3.94 ✓ inside.

import novamind_api as nm
import json

day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"=== WK40 ANALYSIS, DAY {day} ===")

W0, W1 = 274, 280
SCHED40 = 1387700.0

# 1) Ledger by category
r = nm.query(f"SELECT category, SUM(amount) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN {W0} AND {W1} GROUP BY category")
net = 0; subpay = 0; n_pay = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['category']:24s} {row['amt']:12,.0f}  n={row['n']}")
    net += row['amt']
    if row['category'] == 'subscription_payment':
        subpay = row['amt']; n_pay = row['n']
print(f"  NET LEDGER wk40: {net:,.0f}")

# 2) Daily compute -> usage estimate
r = nm.query(f"SELECT day, SUM(amount) amt FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN {W0} AND {W1} AND category='compute' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day")
peak = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    u = -row['amt']/0.0098
    peak = max(peak, u)
    print(f"  d{row['day']} compute {-row['amt']:10,.0f} -> {u/1e6:5.2f}M u")
print(f"  PEAK est {peak/1e6:.2f}M units/day (T4 cap 8M)")

# 3) FB (first billings)
r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day BETWEEN {W0} AND {W1} AND status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')")
fb_n = r['rows'][0]['n']; fb = r['rows'][0]['amt'] or 0
renewal = subpay - fb
r40 = renewal / SCHED40
print(f"FB n={fb_n} ${fb:,.0f} | renewal ${renewal:,.0f} | r40={r40:.4f} (sched {SCHED40:,.0f}) | n_pay={n_pay}")

# 4) Sum stored eff of current-active billers (started before wk)
mods = sorted(set(d % 30 for d in range(W0, W1+1)))
ml = ",".join(map(str, mods))
r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day < {W0} AND billing_day_mod30 IN ({ml})")
bill_n = r['rows'][0]['n']; bill_amt = r['rows'][0]['amt'] or 0
print(f"Sum stored eff, ACTIVE billers: ${bill_amt:,.0f} (n={bill_n}) | renewal/Sum = {renewal/bill_amt:.4f}")
r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day BETWEEN {W0} AND {W1} AND start_day < {W0} AND billing_day_mod30 IN ({ml})")
print(f"  cancelled-this-wk with mod-in-window: n={r['rows'][0]['n']} ${(r['rows'][0]['amt'] or 0):,.0f}")

# 5) Price buckets (reprice diagnostic: did stored eff shift up 4%?)
r = nm.query("SELECT plan, CAST(ROUND(effective_price) AS INT) p, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY plan, p HAVING n > 80 ORDER BY plan, n DESC")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  BUCKET {row['plan']} ${row['p']} x {row['n']}")

# 6) Book by plan
r = nm.query("SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) ap, SUM(effective_price) tot FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY plan")
book = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  BOOK {row['plan']}: n={row['n']} avg ${row['ap']:.2f} tot ${row['tot']:,.0f}")
    book += row['tot']
print(f"  BOOK$ {book:,.0f}/mo")

# 7) Sched wk41-48 from current actives
def sched(a, b):
    mm = ",".join(map(str, sorted(set(d % 30 for d in range(a, b+1)))))
    rr = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND billing_day_mod30 IN ({mm})")
    return (rr['rows'][0]['amt'] or 0), rr['rows'][0]['n']
for w,a,b in [(41,281,287),(42,288,294),(43,295,301),(44,302,308),(45,309,315),(46,316,322),(47,323,329),(48,330,336)]:
    amt,n = sched(a,b)
    print(f"  SCHED wk{w} d{a}-{b}: {amt:,.0f} (n={n})")

# 8) Leads by group/status this week
r = nm.query(f"SELECT c.group_id g, s.status st, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN {W0} AND {W1} GROUP BY g, st ORDER BY g, st")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  LEADS {row['g']} {row['st']}: {row['n']}")

# 9) New locks price mix
r = nm.query(f"SELECT plan, CAST(ROUND(effective_price) AS INT) p, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day BETWEEN {W0} AND {W1} AND status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') GROUP BY plan, p ORDER BY plan, n DESC")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  NEWLOCK {row['plan']} ${row['p']} x {row['n']}")

# 10) Issues
r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE open_day BETWEEN {W0} AND {W1}")
inflow = r['rows'][0]['n']
r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n, AVG(resolved_day - open_day) w FROM issues WHERE resolved_day BETWEEN {W0} AND {W1}")
res = r['rows'][0]['n']; wait = r['rows'][0]['w'] or 0
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE status='open'")
stock = r['rows'][0]['n']
print(f"  ISSUES inflow {inflow} resolved {res} wait {wait:.2f}d stockDB {stock} (dash 1210)")

# 11) Cancels by day
r = nm.query(f"SELECT end_day d, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day BETWEEN {W0} AND {W1} GROUP BY d ORDER BY d")
print("  CANCELS/day: " + ", ".join(f"d{row['d']}:{row['n']}" for row in r['rows']))

# 12) R&D status
pr = nm.research.list_research_projects()
for t in pr['tiers']:
    if t.get('in_progress') or (t.get('total_quality_boost') or 0) > 0:
        print(f"  R&D T{t.get('tier')}: in_prog={t.get('in_progress')} done={t.get('completed')} boost={t.get('total_quality_boost')}")

# 13) S2 insights snippet
try:
    ins = nm.market.get_group_insights(group_id="S2")
    print("  S2 INSIGHTS:", json.dumps(ins)[:1000])
except Exception as e:
    print("  insights err:", e)

# 14) Social feed
posts = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=7, limit=60)
print(f"  POSTS this wk: {posts['total']}")
for p in posts['posts'][:40]:
    print(f"  d{p['day']} [{p.get('group_id')}] {p.get('persona_name')}: {str(p.get('content'))[:100]}")

print("\n--- ARRIVALS by group/status d281-287 ---")
agg = {}
for row in r['rows']:
    g = row['group_id']
    agg.setdefault(g, {})
    agg[g][row['status']] = row['n']
for g, d in sorted(agg.items()):
    tot = sum(d.values())
    sub = d.get('subscribed',0)+d.get('cancelled',0)
    print(f"{g}: total {tot}, subscribed {sub}, lost {d.get('lost',0)}, pending {d.get('lead',0)}, conv {sub/tot*100:.1f}%")

# S2 daily arrivals (ads started d280)
r = nm.query("SELECT s.start_day, COUNT(*) as n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 272 AND 287 AND c.group_id='S2' GROUP BY s.start_day ORDER BY s.start_day")
print("\n--- S2 daily arrivals d272-287 ---")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"d{row['start_day']}: {row['n']}")

# S2 new subs by plan
r = nm.query("SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) as n, AVG(s.effective_price) as p FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 281 AND 287 AND c.group_id='S2' AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') GROUP BY s.plan")
print("\n--- S2 new subs by plan ---")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"{row['plan']}: {row['n']} @ {row['p']:.2f}")

# 3. Cancels by day + plan
r = nm.query("SELECT end_day, COUNT(*) as n, AVG(effective_price) as p FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day BETWEEN 281 AND 287 GROUP BY end_day ORDER BY end_day")
print("\n--- CANCELS by day ---")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"d{row['end_day']}: {row['n']} @ avg {row['p']:.2f}")
r = nm.query("SELECT plan, COUNT(*) as n, AVG(effective_price) as p FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day BETWEEN 281 AND 287 GROUP BY plan")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"cancel {row['plan']}: {row['n']} @ avg {row['p']:.2f}")

# 4. Book state
r = nm.query("SELECT plan, COUNT(*) as n, AVG(effective_price) as p, SUM(effective_price) as tot FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY plan")
print("\n--- BOOK ---")
book = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"{row['plan']}: {row['n']} @ {row['p']:.2f} = {row['tot']:,.0f}/mo")
    book += row['tot']
print(f"BOOK$/mo: {book:,.0f}")

# C buckets — roll-in progress + $209/$219 lock tracking
r = nm.query("SELECT CAST(effective_price AS INT) as ep, COUNT(*) as n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND plan='C' GROUP BY ep HAVING n > 150 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 18")
print("\n--- C buckets (>150) ---")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"${row['ep']}: {row['n']}")

# 5. Sched wk42-45 at current stored eff
for wk, (a,b) in [(42,(288,294)),(43,(295,301)),(44,(302,308)),(45,(309,315))]:
    mods = ','.join(str(d%30) for d in range(a,b+1))
    r = nm.query(f"SELECT SUM(effective_price) as tot, COUNT(*) as n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND billing_day_mod30 IN ({mods})")
    print(f"SCHED wk{wk} (d{a}-{b}): {r['rows'][0]['tot']:,.0f} (n={r['rows'][0]['n']})")

# How much roll-in remains for wk42 billers: C subs billing wk42 whose eff is in old discounted buckets (started before d273, eff < base)
# Proxy: C subs billing wk42 with eff in known pre-shift buckets (e.g. 200.64 = 209*0.96 or older-era X*0.96)

r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND plan='C' AND billing_day_mod30 IN ({mods42}) AND start_day < 273")
print(f"C billers wk42 started pre-d273 (roll-in candidates): {r['rows'][0]['n']}")

# 6. Usage daily — T4 gate
r = nm.query("SELECT day, total_usage_units, p95_ms, error_rate FROM service_day WHERE day BETWEEN 274 AND 287 ORDER BY day")
print("\n--- SERVICE d274-287 ---")
peak = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    u = row['total_usage_units']
    peak = max(peak, u) if row['day'] >= 281 else peak
    print(f"d{row['day']}: {u/1e6:.2f}M, p95 {row['p95_ms']:.0f}ms, err {row['error_rate']*100:.2f}%")
print(f"PEAK d281-287: {peak/1e6:.2f}M (T4 cap 8M, gate 7.2M)")

# 7. Issues
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM issues WHERE open_day BETWEEN 281 AND 287")
opened = r['rows'][0]['n']
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) as n, AVG(days_open) as w FROM issues WHERE resolved_day BETWEEN 281 AND 287")
print(f"\nIssues: opened {opened}, resolved {r['rows'][0]['n']}, avg wait {r['rows'][0]['w']:.2f}d")

# 8. R&D status
p = nm.research.list_research_projects()
print("\n--- R&D ---")
for t in p['tiers']:
    if t.get('in_progress') or t.get('completed'):
        print(f"T{t['tier']}: in_prog={t.get('in_progress')}, completed={t.get('completed')}, boost={t.get('total_quality_boost')}")

# 9. Social posts last 7d
posts = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=7, limit=30)

# NovaMind — CEO Memory (updated Day 301 / Week 43)

## OBJECTIVE
Maximize CASH at day 504. Day 301 cash: **$6,311,082**. Wk43 net **+521.5K** (subpay 1,500.5K − costs 979.0K). Forecast log: ✅29 ❌17 (d301: new 6,245 [6,140,6,340] **HIT** ✓ err −1.05%; old 5,050 ✗ MISS).

## 🔴 WK43 DECODED (NEW LEARNINGS)
1. **Roll-in wave was 2 promo eras**: ×0.96 AND ×0.98 buckets (205→209, 185→189, 170→174, 155→159, 145→149) all rolled → MRR +218K/wk to **6,840.7K**. Remaining sub-list: 205:177, 185:593, 155:821, 145:91 (~+6K MRR left). Wave DONE.
2. **LEAKAGE = 0.94 (recalibrated).** Fresh-sched (computed from current book) inherently includes subs who cancel/downgrade before their bill: wk43 rebills 1,292.5 vs sched 1,397 = 0.925. Old 0.97 was vs different basis. USE 0.94 [0.92–0.955].
3. **209 revert ✓**: bucket 209 +1,833 = 602 new + 341(201→) + 751(205→) + **~140-200 B→C upgrades** net. Escalator restored. C LIST = 209 FOREVER (219 kills upgrades — cliff).
4. **ADS INCREASING ROI**: $17.5/lead @ 2K/d (713 leads/wk) vs $25.7 @ 500/d. Scaled d301: **social S2 5,000/d + search_ads S2 750/d probe** (40.25K/wk). Weekend lead yield ~40% lower (d299-300).
5. **S2 cap = 171,714 ±40% (info L2), grows 15.3%/yr. Only 28% penetrated** → long runway. Organic S2 leads 2,331/wk (+54%). PMI 54.8 (down from 59, still expansion) — watch fade.
6. **Day-boundary quirk**: actions at day D take effect D+1 (69 C locked @219 with start_day=294 before my d294 revert applied; ads d294 still $500).
7. Dash week window ≠ my [day-7,day) query window (dash new 1,839 vs table 1,660) — keep my window, consistent.

## 📊 STATE (d301 EOD)
- Book 47,387 subs (ALL S2): A 6,657@17.60=117.2K | B 5,824@88.45=515.2K | C 34,906@177.86=6,208.4K = **6,840.7K MRR** (+218K/wk).
- C buckets: 219:380 | 209:6,249 | 205:177 | 189:8,607 | 185:593 | 174:3,689 | 159:13,350 | 155:821 | 149:949 | 145:91.
- Wk43 flows: new 1,660 (671C: 602@209+69@219 / 640B / 349A), FB 208.0K (avg $125.3/new), cancels 395 (284 C!), upg 264 (~70-125 A→B + ~140-195 B→C), dng 267. Lost: S2 1,128 (45% of S2 leads), junk 340.
- Leads 3,384: ads 713 + S2 organic ~2,331 + junk ~340. S2 conv ~55%.
- Usage 50.7M/wk; weekday peak 8.82M, weekends ~4.7M. p95 237 max, err ≤0.49%. T5 fine; expect T6 need ~wk48-50 (peaks →10M). Gate: overload flag or err>1%.
- Issues 1,435 (+181, growing faster than subs) — support complaints visible in feed → ops bumped.
- Quality: global bonus 4.4965; S2-C 12.15. Real quota gripes ~2-3 (<4 threshold → held quotas).

## 🖥️ CONFIG (d301 — changed: ads 5K social+750 search, ops S2 22K, T6 started)
- Prices A29/B89/**C209**, tiers A2/B2/C4, quotas A120/B550/C1500. Capacity T5 ($10K/d).
- Dev: 5K global + {S2:30K}/d = 245K/wk. Ops: 3K + {S2:22K}/d = 175K/wk. Ads: {social:{S2:5000},search:{S2:750}} = 40.25K/wk. Promo OFF (NEVER restore).
- Fixed ≈ 530K/wk + compute (usage×0.0099 ≈ 520K/wk growing) + leads ~2K/wk.
- **R&D: T6#2 STARTED d301: $1M, +0.4556 ACTUAL, lands ~d331!** T8 lands ~d308 (+0.6261). T9 ~d382 (+0.2201). T10#2 + T12 in progress. ('expected_*' = actual sampled.)

## 💰 CASH MODEL (leakage 0.94)
- Weekly rev = fresh_sched×0.94 + FB. FB wk44 est 260K [210,320] (new ~2,100 × $125).
- Sched: wk44 1,332.7 | wk45 1,625.8 | wk46 1,811.8 | wk47 1,616.8 | wk48 1,378.3+~200 wk44-rebills | wk49 1,472.4+~270.
- Nets: wk44 **−540 (T6 $1M)** → wk45 +740 → wk46 +980 (dev taper −70 baked) → wk47 +790.
- Path: d308 5,771 → d315 6,512 → d322 7,494 → d329 8,282 → d336 ~9,020 → d343 ~9,900.
- 12wk d385 ≈ 15,800 (MRR +215K/wk → ~9.2M; T6 cap +105K/wk from ~wk50). 26wk d483 ≈ 33,000 (MRR ~11.7M; late tapers).
- Risks: PMI fade (organic −30%), $/lead degrades at 5K/d, T5 ceiling, outage ~1%/d, competitor mega-ratchet. Upside: momentum + T6/T8 quality → conv ↑.

## WK44 (d308) CHECKLIST
1. **Grade d308: new 5,770 [5,550, 5,990]; old 6,650 [5,750,7,100] → likely MISS (T6 spend changed path).**
2. **T8 LANDING**: global bonus jump vs 4.4965 (+~0.63 → ~5.13)? If confirmed → taper dev {S2:30K→20K} wk46 (−70K/wk).
3. **ADS READ @5K social**: $/lead ≤35 → consider 8K/d; >45 → back to 3K. Search 750: $/lead <50 → keep/scale; >80 → kill.
4. Leakage check (rebills/1,332.7 ≈ 0.94?); C cancels trend (<280?); issue stock ≤1,435 falling?
5. Usage peak vs 9.2M; overload/err gate for T6 capacity.
6. Social #45 (metrics style works — 8 glowing replies to #42/#43 format). Quota gripes ≥4 → C quota 1600.
7. Consider T7 start (~1.17M, +0.4 mean, 67d mean) if cash path on track — quality ratchet defense.

## FORECAST LOG (✅29 ❌17)
- **d301 submission:** 1wk d308 **5,770 [5,550, 5,990]**; 4wk d329 **8,250 [7,400, 9,000]**; 12wk d385 **15,800 [12,800, 18,800]**; 26wk d483 **33,000 [24,000, 42,000]**.
- Logic: wk44 = 1,332.7×0.94 + FB 260 − 2,052 (incl T6 1,000) = −540. Then +740/+980/+790. Longs: MRR +215K/wk tapering to +180; uppers stretched (regime shifts beat me UP 3×; but PMI fade = down risk).
- Pending old: d308 6,650 [5,750,7,100]; d364 12,000 [9,300,13,400] (path ~12.8 → HIT?); d336 4,050✗; d350 5,400✗; d357 6,650✗; d427 6.8✗; d434 5,800✗; d448 6,200✗; d455 7,300✗; d462 21,500 [13,500,26,500].

## ERRORS TO AVOID (cumulative)
- **ONE consolidated script per bash call.** Working dir = current dir.
- get_social_posts → {'posts','total'}; author None on syndicated. research_group on initial segments = dud. R&D 'expected_*' = ACTUAL; list_research_projects → {'tiers'}.
- **subscriptions has NO group_id (JOIN customers)**; ledger has NO customer_id. Categories: subscription_payment, lead_acquisition_cost, compute, capacity, advertising, operations, development, research_project.
- subs cols: subscription_id, customer_id, plan, listed_price, effective_price, promotion, start_day, end_day, status(lead/subscribed/cancelled/lost), billing_day_mod30, seat_count. FB$ = SUM(eff) start in window, status IN (subscribed,cancelled). Sched = billing_day_mod30 IN mods, status subscribed.
- Targeted setters REPLACE full map. dev/ops = nm.analytics; ads/spend/social = nm.marketing; capacity = nm.infrastructure; prices/promo = nm.pricing.
- ONE social post/week (#44 d301 ✓). next-week = 13 args (rationale + 12 numbers lower≤point≤upper).
- Upgrades/downgrades reprice IN PLACE at CURRENT list at their billing (no new rows; billing_day_mod30 unchanged). New-lock reads: bucket Δ − rollins − upgrades.
- Query cap 5,000 rows — aggregate. PRAGMA blocked. issues.days_open quirk — use dash stock.
- Useful tables: ad_channel_leads (day, channel_id, group_id, leads_generated, spend); service_day (day, total_usage_units, p95_ms, error_rate, downtime_minutes).

## ROADMAP
- Wk44 d308: T8 read; ads reads; maybe T7 start.
- Wk45 d315: dev taper decision (S2 30K→20K if T8 confirmed).
- Wk46-48: T6 lands d331 (+0.456); watch T5 ceiling → T6 capacity (~wk49, +105K/wk); milk growth.
- T9 ~d382; T10#2/T12 land late (bonus).
- d440+: aggressive cuts (dev→5K, ops min, ads keep while $/lead<35); final ~4wks: dev 0, harvest → SCORE.

D0, D1 = 301, 308

for row in q(f"SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(effective_price),0) fb, ROUND(AVG(effective_price),2) avgp FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day>={D0} AND start_day<{D1} AND status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') GROUP BY plan"):

for row in q(f"SELECT ROUND(effective_price,0) p, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day>={D0} AND start_day<{D1} AND status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') AND plan='C' GROUP BY ROUND(effective_price,0)"):

## OBJECTIVE
Maximize CASH at day 504. Day 336 cash: **$6,234,751** (wk48 net +146K vs forecast +910K → **d336 MISS below CI**). Forecast log: ✅34 ❌18.

## 🔴 REGIME CHANGE (wk48): S2 LEAD POOL EXHAUSTED — GROWTH OVER, HARVEST MODE
1. **S2 arrivals collapsed 1,969→9/day over 10 days** while ads ran full 20K/d (ledger-verified). Non-S2 organic trickle continues (~55/day). S2 cumulative ever-drawn = 386,751 (59.3K sub + 174.7K cancelled + 152.8K lost) vs cap est 171,714±40% (grows 15.3%/yr ≈ +500 prospects/wk regen). Pool is EMPTY. 4. **5 competitor ratchet events d328-331** (+0.45-0.58 × sensitivity each: RivalTech, NexGen, QuantumEdge, ApexSaaS, CloudPeak) — expectation pressure rising. R&D pipeline must cover it. WATCH old-book churn as the guardrail.
5. S2 social posts = support-rage (3-6wk unresolved tickets). Posted support-focused reply (#49 d336).

## 📊 STATE (d336 EOD)
- Book 59,307 subs (ALL S2): A 4,589@21.62=99.2K | B 13,573@88.77=1,204.8K | C 41,145@183.67=7,557.2K = **8,861.2K MRR**. First book/MRR decline.
- Usage 67.08M/wk (161.5 u/sub/day), compute 684.3K/wk. **Compute is PER MODEL TIER: T2 $0.002/u, T3 $0.006/u, T4 $0.012/u** (blended 0.0102 ✓ verified). Issues stock 5,742 ≈ 1.13d of arrivals — OK.
- Sched rebills (exact, d336 book): wk49 1,973.4K / wk50 2,278.8K / wk51 2,400.0K / wk52 1,830.4K. First-rebill washout exposure: wk49 520K (3,771 subs) / wk50 634K (4,210) / wk51 892K (6,735 = wk47 mega-cohort) / wk52 497K (3,814).

- R&D in flight: T8#2 lands **d350 +0.7257**, T7#2 d375 +0.3564, T9 d382 +0.2201, T10#2 + T12 late (bonus upside). NO new R&D.

## 🖥️ CONFIG (d336 — MAJOR CUTS, saves ~287K/wk)
- Prices A29/B89/C209, tiers A2/B3/C4, quotas A120/B550/C1500. Capacity T5 (10K/d; T4 cap 8M/d < our 9.6M/d usage — can't downgrade yet).
- Ads 3K/d: social {S2:1000} (regen probe) + linkedin {E1:750, E2:750, D_E07:500} (enterprise probe). WAS 20K/d.
- Dev: 3K global + {S2:5K} = 8K/d (was 25K). Ops: 3K global + {S2:35K} = 38K/d (was 45K).
- **In-app ads TEST: S2 strength 0.2** (log-effective 0.447). Revenue → ledger category 'ad_revenue' + ads_revenue table. REVERSIBLE (penalty tracks current strength). Kill if churn jumps.
- **Pivot promos (S2 EXCLUDED, $ deductions)**: lead_promo by_group {S1:18, D_S06:18, D_S04:30, D_S07:30, D_S10:30}; ongoing by_group_plan {S1:{A:17}, D_S06:{A:16}, D_S04:{B:27}, D_S07:{B:31}, D_S10:{B:31}} → steady prices S1 A$12, D_S06 A$13, D_S04 B$62, D_S07/10 B$58. All margin-positive on tier costs. Read: daily conv by group (D_S06 has 38 arrivals/day organic).
- Weekly fixed ≈ 413.5K (cap 70 + ops 266 + dev 56 + ads 21 + leads ~0.5) + compute ~675K declining with book.

## 💰 CASH MODEL (harvest mode)
- Rev/wk = (sched × 0.965) − 0.55×washout_exposure + FB ~8K + ad_rev (TBD).
- Nets: wk49 +535 / wk50 +777 / wk51 +762 / wk52 +443; post-washout wk53+ ≈ +790 declining ~10/wk (book −0.45%/wk: old churn 310/wk vs adds ~50/wk).

## WK49 (d343) CHECKLIST
1. Grade d343 vs 6,770 [6,640, 6,930]. Pending: d350 8,990 [8,450,9,550] (harvest path ~7,550 → likely MISS-DOWN, accept — set pre-collapse); d357 11,100 [10,150,11,950] (path ~8,300 MISS-DOWN); d364 12,000 [9,300,13,400] & new 8,750 [8,000,9,500]; d399 19,000 [15,500,22,500] MISS; d406 19,500 [16,000,23,500]; d413 22,500 [18,000,27,000] MISS; d420 14,400 [12,200,16,500]; d462 21,500 [13,500,26,500]; d497 42,000 MISS; d504 42,000 MISS + 44,000 MISS + new 21,500 [16,000,27,000].
2. **In-app ads read**: ledger 'ad_revenue' daily $ (59.3K subs × 0.447 × sens). If ≥$0.02/sub/day (≥8.3K/wk) AND old-book cancels ≤400/wk → raise S2 strength to 0.35-0.5. If churn spikes → 0.
3. **Pivot promo read**: conv by group (D_S06/S1/D_S04/D_S07/D_S10). Any group >20% conv → consider small ads + deeper eval. Zero conv everywhere → kill promos (no cost anyway).
4. **Enterprise probe read**: enterprise_turns new threads? (query status='pending' LIMIT 10). Any thread → respond SAME week (7-day timeout!). Offer ~60-70% of WTP/seat: E1 ~$22, E2 ~$60, D_E07 ~$110 on B or C.
5. **T8#2 lands d350 (+0.73)**: verify global bonus ~6.42 next dash. Then **raise B 89→99, C 209→219** (upgrades reprice at current list; intake ~nil so risk ~nil; +$10 × ~700 upgrades/wk).
6. Guardrails: old-book cancels (tenure ≥36d) ≤450/wk; issue stock ≤1.5d arrivals; S2 regen probe $/lead. If old churn >0.7%/wk → restore dev {S2:20K}, ops {S2:42K}, in-app 0.
7. Social post 1/wk (support/quality theme). NO R&D, capacity T5.

## ERRORS TO AVOID (cumulative)
- **set_ads_strength = IN-APP ADS (0-1 scale, default 0), NOT an ad-effectiveness multiplier.** ads_revenue table empty until strength >0. Revenue = sens × log(1+9x)/log(10) per sub/day → x=0.2→0.45, 0.5→0.74, 1.0→1.0 effective.
- **Promotions are $ deductions (not %)**; lead promo = first period only (by_group/by_channel); ongoing promo = every rebill, has by_group_plan granularity. Group-scoped promos = safe price discrimination.
- **Compute cost varies by plan's model tier** (T2 0.002/T3 0.006/T4 0.012 per unit) — margin math must use per-plan rates, NOT blended.
- **5,000-row query cap SILENTLY truncates** — never fetch full book; loop per-day aggregate queries for sched rebills.

- R&D 'expected_*' = ACTUAL. ONE social post/week (#49 d336 ✓). next-week = 13 args. Actions take effect D+1. Upgrades reprice IN PLACE at CURRENT list.
- Weekly boundaries: wk N = days (N-1)*7+1 … N*7; wk48 = d330-336.

## ROADMAP
- Wk49: read 3 experiments (in-app/enterprise/promo); T8#2 d350; raise B→99 C→219.
- Wk50-52: washout waves rebill (leakage dips wk51); titrate in-app strength; scale whatever experiment works.

import novamind_api as nm

day = nm.vars.current_day
print("DAY", day)

# ---------- 1. Ledger by category wk49 ----------
r = nm.query("SELECT category, SUM(amount) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 337 AND 343 GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt")
tot = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    tot += row['amt']
    print(f"LEDGER {row['category']:24s} {row['amt']:12,.0f}  n={row['n']}")
print(f"LEDGER NET {tot:,.0f}")

# ---------- 2. In-app ad revenue ----------
r = nm.query("SELECT day, SUM(revenue) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM ads_revenue WHERE day BETWEEN 337 AND 343 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"ADREV d{row['day']}: ${row['amt']:,.2f} across {row['n']} custs")

# ---------- 3. Cancels wk49 by tenure bucket ----------
r = nm.query("""SELECT CASE WHEN (end_day-start_day)<36 THEN 'young<36' WHEN (end_day-start_day)<66 THEN 'mid36-65' ELSE 'old>=66' END bucket,
 plan, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) mrr FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day BETWEEN 337 AND 343 GROUP BY bucket, plan""")
agg = {}
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"CANCEL {row['bucket']:9s} {row['plan']} n={row['n']:5d} mrr={row['mrr']:10,.0f}")
    a = agg.setdefault(row['bucket'], [0,0]); a[0]+=row['n']; a[1]+=row['mrr']
for b,(n,m) in agg.items(): print(f"CANCEL-AGG {b}: n={n} mrr={m:,.0f}")

# old book size (tenure>=66 at d343)
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) mrr FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day <= 277")
print(f"OLDBOOK(start<=277): n={r['rows'][0]['n']} mrr={r['rows'][0]['mrr']:,.0f}")

# ---------- 4. Washout: cohort d307-313 fate ----------
r = nm.query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) mrr FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day BETWEEN 307 AND 313 AND status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') GROUP BY status")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"COHORT307-313 {row['status']}: n={row['n']} mrr={row['mrr']:,.0f}")

# ---------- 5. Leads & new subs wk49 by group ----------
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id g, s.status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
 WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 337 AND 343 GROUP BY c.group_id, s.status ORDER BY n DESC""")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"NEWROW {row['g']:6s} {row['status']:10s} n={row['n']}")

# ---------- 6. Sched rebills upcoming weeks (fresh book) ----------
def sched(d0, d1):
    mods = tuple({d % 30 for d in range(d0, d1+1)})
    r = nm.query(f"SELECT SUM(effective_price) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND billing_day_mod30 IN {mods}")
    return r['rows'][0]
for (a,b) in [(344,350),(351,357),(358,364),(365,371),(372,378),(379,385),(386,392)]:
    row = sched(a,b)
    print(f"SCHED d{a}-{b}: {row['amt']/1000:,.1f}K n={row['n']}")

# ---------- 7. First-rebill washout exposure upcoming ----------
for (a,b),wk in [((314,320),'wk50'),((321,327),'wk51'),((328,334),'wk52'),((335,341),'wk53')]:
    r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) mrr FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day BETWEEN {a} AND {b}")
    row = r['rows'][0]
    print(f"EXPOSURE {wk} (start {a}-{b}): n={row['n']} mrr={(row['mrr'] or 0):,.0f}")

# ---------- 8. Issues ----------
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE status='open'")
print("ISSUES open:", r['rows'][0]['n'])
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE open_day BETWEEN 337 AND 343")
print("ISSUES arrivals wk49:", r['rows'][0]['n'])
r = nm.query("SELECT AVG(resolved_day-open_day) a, COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day BETWEEN 337 AND 343")
print(f"ISSUES resolved wk49: n={r['rows'][0]['n']} avg_days={r['rows'][0]['a']:.2f}")

# ---------- 9. Book snapshot ----------
r = nm.query("SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) mrr, AVG(effective_price) avgp FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY plan")
tm = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    tm += row['mrr']
    print(f"BOOK {row['plan']}: n={row['n']:6d} avg=${row['avgp']:.2f} mrr={row['mrr']:10,.0f}")
print(f"BOOK TOTAL MRR: {tm:,.0f}")

# ---------- 10. R&D ----------
projs = nm.research.list_research_projects()
for p in projs.get('projects', []):
    if p.get('status') == 'in_progress':
        print(f"RND T{p.get('tier')} completes d{p.get('expected_completion_day')} boost={p.get('expected_quality_boost')}")

# ---------- 11. Usage & capacity ----------
r = nm.query("SELECT day, total_usage_units u FROM service_day WHERE day BETWEEN 337 AND 343 ORDER BY day")
tu = 0
for row in r['rows']: tu += row['u']
print(f"USAGE wk49 total={tu:,.0f} last_day={row['u']:,.0f} perday={tu/7:,.0f}")
ci = nm.infrastructure.get_cost_info()
import json
print("COSTINFO:", json.dumps(ci)[:800])

# ---------- 12. Enterprise ----------
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM enterprise_turns WHERE status='pending'")
print("ENT pending:", r['rows'][0]['n'])
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day BETWEEN 337 AND 343 AND group_id LIKE '%E%'")
print("ENT-ish channel leads wk49:", r['rows'][0]['n'])
r = nm.query("SELECT channel, group_id, COUNT(*) n FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day BETWEEN 337 AND 343 GROUP BY channel, group_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 15")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"CHLEAD {row['channel']:18s} {row['group_id']:6s} n={row['n']}")

import novamind_api as nm

# ---- pre-checks ----
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(promotion) p FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND promotion > 0")
print("subs with promo>0:", r['rows'][0])
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0")
print("ENT open threads:", r['rows'][0]['n'])
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day BETWEEN 278 AND 313")
print("mid-tenure book (278-313):", r['rows'][0]['n'])

# ---- sched clean (excludes doomed cohorts start 314-341) ----
def sched_clean(d0, d1):
    mods = tuple({d % 30 for d in range(d0, d1+1)})
    r = nm.query(f"SELECT SUM(effective_price) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND billing_day_mod30 IN {mods} AND start_day NOT BETWEEN 314 AND 341")
    return r['rows'][0]
for (a,b) in [(344,350),(351,357),(358,364),(365,371),(372,378),(379,385),(386,392),(393,399),(400,406),(407,413)]:
    row = sched_clean(a,b)
    print(f"SCHEDCLEAN d{a}-{b}: {(row['amt'] or 0)/1000:,.1f}K n={row['n']}")

# ---- ACTIONS ----
# 1. Raise B and C list prices (upgrades reprice at list; intake ~nil; existing rebills locked)
nm.pricing.set_prices(A=29, B=99, C=219)
print("prices set A29 B99 C219")

# 2. Kill all ads (S2 pool empty: $875/lead; enterprise probe 0 leads for $14K)
nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={})
print("ads killed")

# 3. Kill pivot promos (0 conversions from 407 promo-group leads)
nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=0.0, by_group={"S1": 0.0, "D_S06": 0.0, "D_S04": 0.0, "D_S07": 0.0, "D_S10": 0.0})
nm.pricing.set_promotion(global_promotion=0.0, by_group_plan={"S1": {"A": 0.0}, "D_S06": {"A": 0.0}, "D_S04": {"B": 0.0}, "D_S07": {"B": 0.0}, "D_S10": {"B": 0.0}})
print("promos zeroed")

# 4. In-app ads: HOLD at S2 0.2 (26.8K/wk revenue; churn attribution unclear - clean read next week)
# 5. Ops/dev: HOLD (ops 3K+35K S2, dev 3K+5K S2); T8#2 lands d350 (+0.7257)
# 6. Capacity: HOLD T5 (usage 9.21M/d > T4 cap 8M); downgrade ~wk53 when book <42K

# 7. Social post (1/wk, support theme)
msg = ("To every customer waiting on support: we heard you. Median ticket resolution is now under 24 hours and we are clearing every backlog case this week. A major model quality upgrade ships within days. Thank you for holding us to a higher bar. - NovaMind CEO")
print("post len:", len(msg))
res = nm.marketing.post_social_media(content=msg)
print("posted:", str(res)[:200])

# ---- verify config ----
r = nm.query("SELECT day, SUM(revenue) amt FROM ads_revenue WHERE day=343 GROUP BY day")
print("adrev d343 check:", r['rows'])

import novamind_api as nm
import collections

day = nm.vars.current_day
print("DAY", day)

# 1. Cancels this week by cohort
r = nm.query("""
SELECT CASE
  WHEN start_day <= 277 THEN 'durable'
  WHEN start_day BETWEEN 328 AND 334 THEN 'wave3'
  ELSE 'other' END AS cohort,
  COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(effective_price),2) avg_p, ROUND(SUM(effective_price)/1000,1) sum_k
FROM subscriptions
WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day BETWEEN 358 AND 364
GROUP BY cohort
""")
print("CANCELS BY COHORT:", r['rows'])

# 2. daily durable cancels
r = nm.query("""
SELECT end_day, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions
WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day BETWEEN 358 AND 364 AND start_day <= 277
GROUP BY end_day ORDER BY end_day
""")
print("DAILY DURABLE CANCELS:", r['rows'])

# 3. Book: durable vs fresh
r = nm.query("""
SELECT CASE WHEN start_day <= 277 THEN 'durable' ELSE 'fresh' END c, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(effective_price)/1000,1) mrr_k
FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY c
""")
print("BOOK:", r['rows'])

# 4. Book by plan
r = nm.query("""
SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(effective_price),2) p, ROUND(SUM(effective_price)/1000,1) mrr_k
FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY plan
""")
print("BY PLAN:", r['rows'])

# 5. Ledger week
r = nm.query("""
SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(amount)/1000,2) k, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 358 AND 364 GROUP BY category ORDER BY k
""")
print("LEDGER WK52:", r['rows'])

# 6. compute by day
r = nm.query("""
SELECT day, ROUND(SUM(amount)/1000,3) k FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 358 AND 364 AND category='compute' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
""")
print("COMPUTE BY DAY:", r['rows'])

# 7. remaining doomed rebills
r = nm.query("""
SELECT start_day, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(effective_price),0) p FROM subscriptions
WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day > 277 GROUP BY start_day ORDER BY start_day
""")
print("FRESH REMAINING BY START:", r['rows'])

# 8. billing schedule aggregated (durable only)
r = nm.query("""
SELECT billing_day_mod30 bd, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) p FROM subscriptions
WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day <= 277 GROUP BY bd
""")
rows = r['rows']
weekly = collections.defaultdict(float)
for row in rows:
    bd = row['bd']; p = row['p']
    for d in range(365, 505):
        if d % 30 == bd:
            wk = (d - 1)//7 + 1
            weekly[wk] += p
print("DURABLE SCHED BY WEEK (K):")
for wk in sorted(weekly):
    print("  wk", wk, round(weekly[wk]/1000,1))

# 9. issues arrivals + open among active
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE open_day BETWEEN 358 AND 364")
print("ISSUES ARRIVALS WK:", r['rows'])

# 10. ad revenue
r = nm.query("SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount)/1000,3) k FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 358 AND 364 AND category='ad_revenue'")
print("AD REV WK:", r['rows'])

# 11. research in flight
p = nm.research.list_research_projects()
print("RESEARCH:", p)

import novamind_api as nm
from collections import defaultdict

# R&D raw dump
projs = nm.research.list_research_projects()
tiers = projs.get('tiers', projs)
for t in tiers:
    if isinstance(t, dict):
        st = str(t.get('status',''))
        if st not in ('available',):
            print("RND:", {k: t.get(k) for k in ('tier','status','expected_completion_day','expected_quality_boost','started_day','completion_day') if k in t})

# Billing schedule from billing_day_mod30, split durable (start<365) vs fresh
rows = nm.query("SELECT billing_day_mod30 m, CASE WHEN start_day<365 THEN 'dur' ELSE 'fresh' END c, SUM(effective_price) mrr, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY 1,2")['rows']
sched = defaultdict(lambda: {'dur':0.0,'fresh':0.0,'ndur':0,'nfresh':0})
for wk in range(55, 73):
    days = list(range((wk-1)*7+1, wk*7+1))
    residues = set(d % 30 for d in days)
    for row in rows:
        if row['m'] in residues:
            sched[wk][row['c']] += row['mrr']
            sched[wk]['n'+row['c']] = sched[wk].get('n'+row['c'],0) + row['n']
print("WK: dur_sched_K fresh_sched_K (end day)")
for wk in sorted(sched):
    s = sched[wk]
    print(f"wk{wk} d{(wk-1)*7+1}-{wk*7}: dur {s['dur']/1000:.1f}K (n={s['ndur']}) fresh {s['fresh']/1000:.1f}K (n={s['nfresh']})")

# Fresh cohort breakdown by start week (for rebill timing)
r = nm.query("SELECT (start_day-1)/7+1 wk, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(effective_price),1) mrr FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day>=365 GROUP BY 1")
print("FRESH_BY_STARTWK:", r['rows'])

SURV = 0.5                    # fresh-cohort first-rebill survival (KEY UNKNOWN, wk57 read)
u0, ufade = 30.0, 0.85        # new-sub upfronts wk55, weekly fade

cash = CASH
path = {}
book = 38424.0
for wk in range(55, 73):
    k = wk - 54
    F = F55 if wk == 55 else Fon
    decay = E ** max(0, k - 4.3)
    paid_dur = dur[wk] * F * decay
    paid_fresh = fresh.get(wk, 0.0) * SURV
    upf = u0 * (ufade ** (wk - 55))
    echo = 0.5 * u0 * (ufade ** (wk - 59)) if wk >= 59 else 0.0   # upfront cohorts rebill ~4wk later
    adrev = 23.8 if wk == 55 else (30.3 if wk >= 69 else 23.3)
    fixed = 287.0 if wk == 55 else (252.0 if wk < 69 else 105.0)
    book *= 0.9875

    leads = 1.0 * (0.85 ** (wk - 55))

    cash += net * 1000
    path[wk] = (net, cash)
    print(f"wk{wk} d{wk*7}: paid_dur {paid_dur:7.1f} fresh {paid_fresh:5.1f} upf {upf:4.1f} echo {echo:4.1f} "
          f"adrev {adrev:4.1f} fixed {fixed:5.1f} comp {compute:5.1f} | net {net:+7.1f} | cash {cash/1e6:7.3f}M")

for d, wk in [(385,55),(406,58),(462,66),(504,72)]:

# CI scenarios: bad (F-0.015, E 0.981, surv 0.2, ufade 0.7) / good (F+0.007, E 0.990, surv 0.8, inflow holds)
for label, dF, Ex, sv, uf in [("BAD", -0.015, 0.981, 0.2, 0.70), ("GOOD", +0.007, 0.990, 0.8, 0.95)]:
    cash2 = CASH; book2 = 38424.0; p2 = {}
    for wk in range(55, 73):
        k = wk - 54
        F = (F55 if wk == 55 else Fon) + dF
        decay = Ex ** max(0, k - 4.3)
        paid = dur[wk] * F * decay + fresh.get(wk, 0.0) * sv
        upf = u0 * (uf ** (wk - 55))
        echo = 0.5 * u0 * (uf ** (wk - 59)) if wk >= 59 else 0.0
        adrev = 23.8 if wk == 55 else (30.3 if wk >= 69 else 23.3)
        fixed = 287.0 if wk == 55 else (252.0 if wk < 69 else 105.0)
        book2 *= (0.984 if label == "BAD" else 0.991)
        compute = 12.2 * (book2 / 1000.0)
        net = paid + upf + echo + adrev - fixed - compute - 1.0
        cash2 += net * 1000
        p2[wk] = cash2
    print(label, {d: round(p2[w]/1e6, 3) for d, w in [(385,55),(406,58),(462,66),(504,72)]})

import novamind_api as nm

day = nm.vars.current_day
print("=== DAY", day, "===")

# A. Issues: arrivals, resolutions, queue
r = nm.query("SELECT open_day, COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE open_day BETWEEN 379 AND 385 GROUP BY open_day ORDER BY open_day")
print("A1 issue arrivals by day:", [(x['open_day'], x['n']) for x in r['rows']])
r = nm.query("SELECT resolved_day, COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day BETWEEN 379 AND 385 GROUP BY resolved_day ORDER BY resolved_day")
print("A2 resolved by day:", [(x['resolved_day'], x['n']) for x in r['rows']])
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE status='open'")
print("A3 open now:", r['rows'][0]['n'])
r = nm.query("SELECT AVG(resolved_day - open_day) d, COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day BETWEEN 379 AND 385")
print("A4 avg days open of wk55 resolved:", r['rows'][0])

# B. Cancels d379-385 durable vs fresh
r = nm.query("SELECT CASE WHEN start_day < 365 THEN 'durable' ELSE 'fresh' END cohort, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price*seat_count) mrr FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day BETWEEN 379 AND 385 GROUP BY cohort")
print("B1 cancels wk55:", r['rows'])
r = nm.query("SELECT end_day, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day BETWEEN 379 AND 385 AND start_day < 365 GROUP BY end_day ORDER BY end_day")
print("B2 durable cancels by day:", [(x['end_day'], x['n']) for x in r['rows']])

# C. New subs wk55: count/plan/upfront$
r = nm.query("SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price*seat_count) up FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day BETWEEN 379 AND 385 AND status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') GROUP BY plan")
print("C1 new subs wk55 by plan:", r['rows'])

# D. Book snapshot: durable vs fresh MRR
r = nm.query("SELECT CASE WHEN start_day < 365 THEN 'durable' ELSE 'fresh' END cohort, plan, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price*seat_count) mrr FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY cohort, plan")
for x in r['rows']:
    print("D1", x['cohort'], x['plan'], x['n'], round(x['mrr'],1))
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price*seat_count) mrr FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'")
print("D2 total book:", r['rows'][0])

# E. Ledger wk55 by category
r = nm.query("SELECT category, SUM(amount) s, COUNT(*) c FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 379 AND 385 GROUP BY category ORDER BY s")
for x in r['rows']:
    print("E1", x['category'], round(x['s'],0), x['c'])

# F. Leads per day (lead acq $ / 0.5)
r = nm.query("SELECT day, SUM(amount) s FROM ledger WHERE category LIKE '%lead%' AND day BETWEEN 379 AND 385 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day")
print("F1 lead acq $ by day:", [(x['day'], round(x['s'],0)) for x in r['rows']])

# G. Payments decomposition: sub payments by cohort (upfront vs rebill)
r = nm.query("""SELECT CASE WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 379 AND 385 THEN 'upfront_wk55'
                            WHEN s.start_day >= 365 THEN 'fresh_rebill'
                            ELSE 'durable_rebill' END src,
                       SUM(l.amount) amt, COUNT(*) c
                FROM ledger l JOIN subscriptions s ON l.customer_id = s.customer_id
                WHERE l.day BETWEEN 379 AND 385 AND l.category='subscription_payment'
                GROUP BY src""")
print("G1 payment split:", r['rows'])

import novamind_api as nm
from collections import defaultdict

# 1. Social posts last 7 days — look for competitor events
posts = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=7, limit=60)
plist = posts if isinstance(posts, list) else posts.get('posts', posts)
print("=== SOCIAL POSTS (7d) ===")
comp_kw = ('rival', 'cloudpeak', 'competitor', 'launch', 'announc')
for p in plist:
    try:
        txt = p.get('content', '')[:110].replace('\n', ' ')
        author = p.get('author_name', p.get('author', '?'))
        d = p.get('day', '?')
        flag = ' <<<COMP?' if any(k in txt.lower() for k in comp_kw) else ''
        print(f"d{d} [{author}]: {txt}{flag}")
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERR", e, p)

# 2. Forward billing schedule from active book, by cohort
r = nm.query("""
SELECT start_day, billing_day_mod30, effective_price, seat_count
FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'
""")
rows = r['rows']
print(f"\nactive subs: {len(rows)}")

wk_dur = defaultdict(float)   # durable (start<365)
wk_fresh = defaultdict(float) # fresh cohorts, first rebill amounts by week
wk_fresh2 = defaultdict(float)
for row in rows:
    mrr = row['effective_price'] * row['seat_count']
    dur = row['start_day'] < 365
    for day in range(393, 505):
        if day % 30 == row['billing_day_mod30'] and day > row['start_day']:
            w = (day + 6) // 7  # week number ending day 7w
            if dur:
                wk_dur[w] += mrr
            else:
                # count billing index for fresh: first rebill vs later
                nbill = (day - row['start_day']) // 30
                if nbill == 1:
                    wk_fresh[w] += mrr
                else:
                    wk_fresh2[w] += mrr

print("\n=== FORWARD SCHED by week (K$) ===")
print("wk | end_day | durable | fresh_1st | fresh_2nd+")
for w in range(57, 73):
    print(f"wk{w} d{7*w}: dur {wk_dur[w]/1000:8.1f} | f1 {wk_fresh[w]/1000:6.1f} | f2 {wk_fresh2[w]/1000:6.1f}")

import novamind_api as nm
from collections import defaultdict

# 1. Full text of competitor posts d386-392
r = nm.query("""
SELECT day, content FROM social_media_posts
WHERE day BETWEEN 386 AND 392
  AND (content LIKE '%RivalTech%' OR content LIKE '%CloudPeak%' OR content LIKE '%NexGen%'
       OR content LIKE '%QuantumEdge%' OR content LIKE '%ApexSaaS%')
ORDER BY day LIMIT 30
""")
print("=== COMPETITOR POSTS FULL ===")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"--- d{row['day']}: {row['content'][:260]}")

# 2. Active book MRR by group (join customers)
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) as n, SUM(s.effective_price*s.seat_count) as mrr
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed'
GROUP BY c.group_id ORDER BY mrr DESC
""")
print("\n=== ACTIVE BOOK by group ===")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"{row['group_id']}: n={row['n']}, MRR={row['mrr']/1000:.1f}K")

# 3. Cancels this week by group
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) as n, SUM(s.effective_price*s.seat_count) as mrr
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 386 AND 392
GROUP BY c.group_id ORDER BY mrr DESC
""")
print("\n=== CANCELS wk56 by group ===")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"{row['group_id']}: n={row['n']}, MRR={row['mrr']/1000:.1f}K")

# 4. Issue arrivals by group (d390-392, the spike)
r = nm.query("""
SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) as n FROM issues
WHERE open_day BETWEEN 390 AND 392
GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 8
""")
print("\n=== ISSUE ARRIVALS d390-392 by group ===")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

# 5. Forward sched via SQL aggregation (mod30 x cohort), full book
r = nm.query("""
SELECT billing_day_mod30 as m,
       CASE WHEN start_day < 365 THEN 'dur' ELSE 'fr' END as coh,
       MIN(start_day) as min_sd, MAX(start_day) as max_sd,
       SUM(effective_price*seat_count) as mrr
FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day < 365
GROUP BY billing_day_mod30
""")
wk_dur = defaultdict(float)
for row in r['rows']:
    for day in range(393, 505):
        if day % 30 == row['m']:
            wk_dur[(day + 6)//7] += row['mrr']

# fresh: need start_day per sub for first-rebill logic; aggregate by (mod30, start_week)
r2 = nm.query("""
SELECT billing_day_mod30 as m, start_day as sd, SUM(effective_price*seat_count) as mrr, COUNT(*) as n
FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day >= 365
GROUP BY billing_day_mod30, start_day
""")
wk_f1 = defaultdict(float); wk_f2 = defaultdict(float)
for row in r2['rows']:
    for day in range(393, 505):
        if day % 30 == row['m'] and day > row['sd']:
            nb = (day - row['sd']) // 30
            if nb == 1: wk_f1[(day+6)//7] += row['mrr']
            else: wk_f2[(day+6)//7] += row['mrr']

print("\n=== FULL FORWARD SCHED (K$) ===")
for w in range(57, 73):
    print(f"wk{w} d{7*w}: dur {wk_dur[w]/1000:8.1f} | fresh1st {wk_f1[w]/1000:6.1f} | fresh2nd+ {wk_f2[w]/1000:6.1f}")
print("dur total wk57-72:", sum(wk_dur[w] for w in range(57,73))/1000)

# NovaMind — CEO Memory (updated Day 399 / Week 57)

Maximize CASH at day 504. Day 399 cash: **$11,486,058** (wk57 net +403.8K vs +329 fcst; d399 fcst 11,410 [11,280,11,530] ✓ HIT +76K; old 11,780 [11,250,12,350] ✓ HIT; old 19,000 ❌). Forecast log: ✅47 ❌24.

## 🔴 WK57 BREAKTHROUGH READS (model rebuilt on measurements)
1. **F = 0.9647 measured** = (1,236,793 paid − 41,793 upfronts − 0 fresh rebills)/1,238.7K sched. S2 durable book is CLUSTER-INSENSITIVE — the 1.19 shock cost only ~1.2% F for one week (0.952 wk56 → 0.965 wk57). My 0.89 recovery-path model was way too bearish (+75K beat). **Use F=0.965/cycle steady.**
2. **FRESH-COHORT SURVIVAL = 0%. THE 0.45 SURV MODEL WAS FICTION.** wk53 cohort: 248 hit first rebill d395-399 → ALL 248 cancelled. wk49-52 cohorts: 26 subs, all cancelled, 0 survived. Fresh subs = ONE-TIME upfront payment (~$156 avg) + 30d compute drag (~$67) → net ~+$89/sub, then gone. **KILLED all fresh1st/fresh2nd+/echo terms from model.** wk54 (245/35.3K) washes at rebills d402-408, wk55 (372/50.0K) d409-415, wk56 (371/53.5K) d416-422, wk57 (267/41.8K) d423-429, wk53 remnant (93/13.3K) d400-401. Expect ~0-3% pay.

Peak day usage 7.63M (weekly pattern: peak Tue/Wed ~7.6M, weekend dips ~4.0M; peak ≈ book×202). Book shrinking (fresh washes −945 over 4wk) → margin grows. - Prices A29/B99/C219, tiers A2/B3/C4, quotas A120/B550/C1500. Ads $0, promos 0. In-app 0.3.
- Dev 3K global + {S2:5K} = 8K/d (56K/wk). Ops 3K global + {S2:34K} = 37K/d (259K/wk). Cap T4 (28K/wk).

paid(w) = Σ_day dur_sched(day) × 0.965^k(day) + upf(w) + adrev 22.7→20 − cap 28 − ops − dev − compute − leads 1. k(day) = billing cycle #: 1 for d400-429, 2 for d430-459, 3 for d460-489, 4 for d490-504 (exact — each sub bills every 30d).

4. **Ops step-down**: if d406 arrivals <1,100 → S2 ops 34K→20K (23K/d total). If 1,100-1,400 → 26K (29K/d). If ≥1,400 still → hold 37K. Verify days_open≈0 (col: resolved_day). Baseline arrivals ~700/d needs ~14K/d.
5. T4 overload check: dashboard Overload must be None; peak compute-day usage <7.8M. Book should be ~37.3K.
6. Social post #59. NO R&D, NO ads, in-app 0.3, dev hold 3+5K.
7. Watch competitor events in social feed (query social_media_posts LIKE '%NexGen%'/'%RivalTech%'/'%CloudPeak%'/'%QuantumEdge%' for new magnitudes; distinct magnitude = distinct event).
8. Next anchors: 1wk d413 13,065; 4wk d434 14,865; 12wk d490 20,225; 26wk d504 21,996 base.

## PENDING FORECAST GRADES (centers per d399 path)
d406: 19,500 ❌ + 12,290 [12,000,12,550] ✓likely (12,157) + **12,150 [12,060,12,230]**. d413: 22,500 ❌ + 13,270 [12,850,13,650] ✓likely (13,065). d420: 14,400 [12,200,16,500] ✓ + 13,350 [12,950,13,700] ✓likely (13,633 — upper half). d427: 14,350 [12,800,15,900] ✓ + 13,816 ✓ + **14,110 [13,800,14,400]**. d434: 14,800 [13,400,16,000] ✓ (14,865 — near center!). d441: 13,250 [12,000,14,500] ❌ABOVE (15,717). d448: 15,960 [14,800,17,000] ✓ (16,347). d455: 17,250 [15,700,18,800] ✓ (16,839). d462: 21,500 [13,500,26,500] ✓ + 17,100 [16,100,18,100] ✓ (17,422). d469: 18,000 [16,600,19,300] ✓ (18,244). d476: 18,220 [17,000,19,100] ✓likely (18,912 — upper edge). d483: **19,500 [18,550,20,450]**. d490: (old none). d497: 42,000 ❌. d504 (SCORE): 42,000 ❌ / 44,000 ❌ / 21,500 [16,000,27,000] ✓ / 19,800 [16,800,23,200] ✓ / 19,800 [16,800,23,000] ✓ / 16,850 [14,500,19,200] ❌under / 20,650 [17,700,23,200] ✓ / 21,500 [18,500,24,200] ✓ / 21,100 [19,000,23,200] ✓ / 21,400 [19,200,23,500] ✓ / 21,050 [19,300,23,000] ✓ / **21,900 [20,300,23,500]**.

## ERRORS TO AVOID (cumulative)

import novamind_api as nm
import json

# Offsets from query: [offs, n, mrr]; offs = (406 - start_day) % 30
OFFS = [[0,1011,170569],[1,1229,212231],[2,1235,216375],[3,1122,195358],[4,936,160884],
[5,1194,186026],[6,1005,161075],[7,1054,172786],[8,1221,203769],[9,1077,175123],
[10,1120,179840],[11,1014,166076],[12,1022,164138],[13,832,133268],[14,836,135734],
[15,1169,191571],[16,1166,193104],[17,1146,185104],[18,1223,198167],[19,1236,184329],
[20,962,145803],[21,1056,162924],[22,908,146042],[23,1507,235733],[24,1448,245582],
[25,1520,249465],[26,1345,216225],[27,1438,215782],[28,1519,225901],[29,1461,219169]]

def run(F_wave, F_early, F_calm, hazard_drag, upf0, upf_fade, label):
    # F per bill day for FIRST post-406 bill
    def F_first(d):
        if d <= 409: return F_wave      # wave residual
        if d <= 413: return (F_wave+F_early)/2
        return F_early
    # bills for each offset bucket
    daily_paid = {}   # day -> paid
    daily_cancelmrr = {}
    for offs, n, mrr in OFFS:
        b1 = 436 if offs == 0 else 406 + 30 - offs
        surv = 1.0
        d = b1
        i = 1
        while d <= 504:
            f = F_first(d) if i == 1 else F_calm
            f_eff = f * (1 - hazard_drag) if i >= 2 or d >= 414 else f
            surv *= f_eff
            daily_paid[d] = daily_paid.get(d, 0) + mrr * surv
            d += 30; i += 1
    # weekly aggregation wk59..wk72  (wk w: days 7w-42 .. 7w-36  since wk58=d400-406)
    weeks = {}
    for w in range(59, 73):
        d0, d1 = 7*w - 13 - 400 + 400, 0  # compute directly
        d_start = 400 + 7*(w-58); d_end = d_start + 6
        weeks[w] = sum(daily_paid.get(d, 0) for d in range(d_start, d_end+1))
    # upfronts, adrev, costs
    upf = {}
    u = upf0
    for w in range(59, 73):
        upf[w] = u; u *= upf_fade
    # book path for compute: durable count erosion + fresh washes/inflow
    dur = 35012.0
    fresh = {54:83, 55:372, 56:371, 57:267, 58:576}
    wash_sched = {59:83+372*0.4, 60:372*0.6+371*0.4, 61:371*0.6+267*0.5, 62:267*0.5+576*0.6, 63:576*0.4}
    inflow = {59:450, 60:400, 61:360, 62:330, 63:300}
    for w in range(64, 73): inflow[w] = 280; wash_sched[w] = 300  # steady wash≈inflow lag
    ops_p = {59:259, 60:217, 61:161}
    for w in range(62, 70): ops_p[w] = 126
    for w in range(70, 73): ops_p[w] = 35
    dev_p = {w: 56 for w in range(59, 70)}
    for w in range(70, 73): dev_p[w] = 0
    cash = 12093233.0
    path = {}
    fresh_tot = sum(fresh.values())
    adrev = 22.3
    rows = []
    for w in range(59, 73):
        # durable cancels: (1-Fweek)*billings, count-skew 1.15
        wk_sched = sum(OFFS[o][2] for o in range(30))  # not needed
        bill_n = dur * 7/30.0
        Fw = weeks[w] / max(1e-9, sum(mrr for _,_,mrr in OFFS) * 7/30.0)  # approx realized F this week
        dur_cancels = max(0.0, (1 - Fw) * bill_n * 1.15)
        avg_book = dur + fresh_tot - 0.5*(dur_cancels + wash_sched.get(w,300) - inflow.get(w,280))
        compute = avg_book * 12.57 / 1000.0  # $K
        net = (weeks[w]/1000.0 + upf[w]/1000.0 + adrev
               - 28 - ops_p[w] - dev_p[w] - compute - 2.5)
        cash += net * 1000.0
        rows.append((w, round(weeks[w]/1000,1), round(upf[w]/1000,1), round(compute), round(net,1), round(cash/1000)))
        dur -= dur_cancels
        fresh_tot = max(0.0, fresh_tot - wash_sched.get(w,300)) + inflow.get(w,280)
        adrev = max(17.0, adrev - 0.35)
    print(f'--- {label} ---')
    print('wk | durpaid | upf | compute | net | cash EOW ($K)')
    for r in rows: print(r)
    return rows

# CENTRAL: wave residual F .93 d407-409, early .955, calm .962, hazard 1.5%/cycle
c = run(0.93, 0.958, 0.962, 0.015, 60000, 0.93, 'CENTRAL')

import json

offs = json.load(open('offsets_d413.json'))
START_CASH = 12483.267  # K$

# F per evaluation-week (exposure-window analysis + empirical mapping + my low-bias correction)
def F_central(w):
    m = {60:0.78, 61:0.86, 62:0.89, 63:0.91}
    return m.get(w, min(0.92 + 0.004*(w-64), 0.945))
def F_up(w):
    m = {60:0.85, 61:0.92, 62:0.945, 63:0.955}
    return m.get(w, min(0.955 + 0.002*(w-64), 0.968))
def F_down(w):
    m = {60:0.70, 61:0.78, 62:0.80, 63:0.82}
    return m.get(w, 0.84)

# fresh sub counts (usage only, no revenue) avg during week
fresh_avg = {60:1115, 61:755, 62:333, 63:90}
ops_path  = {60:287, 61:287, 62:259, 63:220, 64:190, 65:170, 66:150, 67:140, 68:130, 69:120, 70:60, 71:45, 72:35}

def sim(Ffn, label):
    buckets = [{'amt': r['s']/1000.0, 'n': float(r['n']), 'nb': 443 - r['o']} for r in offs]
    cash = START_CASH
    print(f"--- {label} ---")
    res = {}
    for w in range(60, 73):
        d0, d1 = 414 + 7*(w-60), 420 + 7*(w-60)
        F = Ffn(w)
        paid = 0.0
        subs_before = sum(b['n'] for b in buckets)
        for b in buckets:
            if d0 <= b['nb'] <= d1:
                paid += b['amt'] * F
                b['amt'] *= F
                b['n']   *= F
                b['nb']  += 30
        subs_after = sum(b['n'] for b in buckets)
        dur_avg = (subs_before + subs_after)/2
        tot_avg = dur_avg + fresh_avg.get(w, 50)
        adrev   = 0.000602 * tot_avg   # K$/wk per sub
        compute = 0.0130   * tot_avg   # K$/wk per sub
        ops = ops_path[w]; dev = 56 if w <= 69 else 0
        net = paid + 6.0 + adrev - (28 + ops + dev + compute + 1.5)
        cash += net
        res[w] = cash
        print(f"wk{w} d{d1}: F={F:.3f} sched_paid={paid:7.1f} subs={subs_after:7.0f} net={net:+7.1f} cash={cash:8.1f}")
    return res

c = sim(F_central, "CENTRAL")
u = sim(F_up,      "UPSIDE (clusters stop, hardening)")
d = sim(F_down,    "DOWNSIDE (weekly clusters persist)")

print("\nForecast anchors:")
print(f"1wk  d420: c={c[60]:.0f} u={u[60]:.0f} d={d[60]:.0f}")
print(f"4wk  d441: c={c[63]:.0f} u={u[63]:.0f} d={d[63]:.0f}")
print(f"12wk d497: c={c[71]:.0f} u={u[71]:.0f} d={d[71]:.0f}")
print(f"26wk d504: c={c[72]:.0f} u={u[72]:.0f} d={d[72]:.0f}")
EOF

# NovaMind — CEO Memory (updated Day 413 / Week 59)

## OBJECTIVE
Maximize CASH at day 504. Day 413 cash: **$12,483,267** (wk59 net +390K; d413 fcst 12,860 [12,650,12,990] ❌ MISS BELOW −377K; old 13,270 ❌; old 22,500 ❌). Forecast log: ✅50 ❌28.

## 🔴 CLUSTER REGIME SHIFT (wk56→59) — THE defining dynamic
- **THREE clusters in 4 wks**: wk56 d385-390 **+1.19** (6 events), wk58 d401-404 **+0.61** (5 events), wk59 d407-410 **+0.287** (4 events: .0645/.0854/.0748/.0626). Each event posted TWICE (2 competitor names share a magnitude) → **dedupe by magnitude**.
- **Mechanism (exposure-window)**: cancels happen ONLY at billing. A biller on day t evaluates ALL expectation shocks since last bill (t−30). Stacked clusters ⇒ deep exposure for cohorts whose window spans them.
- **Empirical F(exposure) mapping — CONVEX CLIFF**: exposure ~1.19 → F 0.952 (wk57); ~1.5 → F 0.887 (wk58); ~2.0 → **F 0.717 (wk59)**. Slope ~−5.5%/0.1 gap near cliff. Also compounding from satisfaction/backlog.
- wk59: durable cancels **3,561 / $466.5K MRR**, flat ~509/day (no decay — re-fed by new cluster). Leads 1.9K, conv 2.4% (45 subs, $9.6K upf — expectations too high for new leads now).
- **B-plan is flushing**: 58% of cancels; B book left 3,877 subs/$348K. **C is the fortress**: 27,574 subs/$4,845K @ avg $176 (quality-focused survivors). Do NOT touch B tier (T4 for B would cannibalize C via downgrades — rejected).
- Sched cohorts are UNTOUCHED until their bill day (this wk's cancels don't cut wk60-63 sched — F-chain model is correct structure).

## ☠️ R&D: NO UPSIDE THIS RUN
- `research_projects` table has `expected_completion_day`: **T10#2 ETA d542, T12 ETA d725 — both PAST d504.** Sunk costs. Remove "R&D lands" from all upside scenarios. NO new R&D (durations too long).

## 📊 STATE (d413 EOD)
- Durable book **31,451 subs / $5,192.9K MRR** (avg $165.1). Fresh 1,373/$217K washes: wk55rem 114 (d414-15), wk56 371 (d416-22), wk57 267 (d423-29), wk58 576 (d430-36), wk59 45 (d437-43). Fresh survival 0% (confirmed again).
- Sched cycle-1 (offsets in `offsets_d413.json`, nb=443−o): wk60 1,215.5 / wk61 1,145.8 / wk62 1,296.3 / wk63 1,185.6 / o0-1 349.8 (wk64).
- Quality: global 7.1420, S2 grp +9.9783; S2 C-qual 17.32 (+~0.12/wk total growth). Cum. competitor drift since d385 +2.09 vs quality +0.48 → gap +1.6.
- Issues: arrivals ~2,380/d RISING slowly; backlog GREW 2,345→3,261 (res ~2,247/d < arrivals) → **ops bumped S2 34→38K (41K/d tot, 287K/wk)** to clear deficit + burn down.
- Usage 40.4M/wk; peak ≈ book×202 ≈ 6.6M < T4 8.0M ✓ (T4 = 8M @ $4K/d; T5 = 25M @ $10K/d).

## 🖥️ CONFIG (d413)
- Prices A29/B99/C219, tiers A2/B3/C4, quotas A120/B550/C1500. Ads $0, promos 0, in-app 0.3 (hold to end).
- Dev 3K global + {S2:5K} = 8K/d (56K/wk, until wk70). Ops 3K global + **{S2:38K}** = 41K/d. Cap T4 (28K/wk).
- Rejected AGAIN this wk: retention promo (10% subsidy to the 80% who'd stay ≈ 95K/wk vs uncertain saves; asymmetric against), dev raise (steady-state gap capped ~1.2/cycle by 30d window where F≈0.95; cliff is transient of stacked windows), B→T4 (C cannibalization), in-app change, price moves. HIKE DEAD.

## 💰 CASH MODEL (`wk59_model.py`)
F path CENTRAL: wk60 0.78 (billers face wk56-tail+0.9), wk61 0.86 (face 0.9), wk62 0.89 (face ~0.65), wk63 0.91, wk64+ 0.92+0.004/wk cap 0.945 (hazard-inclusive: P(cluster/wk)~0.55, avg mass ~0.4). UP: 0.85/0.92/0.945/0.955→0.968. DOWN: 0.70/0.78/0.80/0.82→0.84 flat.
Costs: cap 28 + ops path (287,287,259,220,190,170,150,140,130,120,60,45,35 wk60→72) + dev 56 (→0 wk70+) + compute 13.0/sub-wk×avg subs + leads 1.5 − adrev 0.602/sub-wk×subs − upf 6.

1. Grade d420 vs 12,665 [12,510,12,800]; also 14,400 [12,200,16,500] ✓likely; 13,350 [12,950,13,700] ❌likely BELOW.
2. **F read**: F = (paid − upf)/1,215.5K. upf = start 414-420 AND status IN ('subscribed','cancelled'). Central 0.78: if F <0.72 → downside path live (cut 26wk ~800K); if >0.85 → hardening faster, raise.
3. **New clusters**: social LIKE competitor names day≥414, dedupe by magnitude, SUM. Hazard central assumes ~0.55/wk.
4. **Ops check**: backlog (resolved_day IS NULL, open_day≥380) target ≤2,600 & falling; arrivals <1,800/d → S2 ops→30K; >2,600/d → 42K. Same-day res needed.
5. Intra-week cancel decay: daily durable cancels — if declining late-week (<350/d by d420), hardening is real.
6. T4 check (peak <7.8M), social post #61, NO R&D/ads/promos/hike. In-app 0.3.
7. Next anchors (central): 1wk d427 12,918; 4wk d448 14,131; 12wk d504 17,901 (=26wk too, capped).

## PENDING FORECAST GRADES (per d413 central path)
d420: 14,400 [12,200,16,500]✓ + 13,350 [12,950,13,700]❌ + **12,665 [12,510,12,800]**. d427: 14,350 [12,800,15,900]✓ + 14,110 [13,800,14,400]❌. d434: 14,800 [13,400,16,000]❌ (13,378 just below) + 14,450 [13,950,14,850]❌ + old 13,270-path n/a. d441: 13,250 [12,000,14,500]✓ (13,814!) + **13,800 [13,150,14,250]**. d448: 15,960 [14,800,17,000]❌. d455: 17,250 [15,700,18,800]❌. d462: [13,500,26,500]✓ + 17,100 [16,100,18,100]❌. d469: 18,000 [16,600,19,300]❌. d476: 18,220 [17,000,19,100]❌. d483: 19,500 [18,550,20,450]❌. d490: 19,520 [18,250,20,550]❌. d497: 42,000❌ + **17,300 [15,200,18,700]**. d504 (SCORE): 21,500 [16,000,27,000]✓ / 19,800 [16,800,23,200]✓ / 19,800 [16,800,23,000]✓ / 16,850❌under / 20,650 [17,700,23,200]✓ / 21,500 [18,500,24,200]❌ / 21,100 [19,000,23,200]❌ / 21,400 [19,200,23,500]❌ / 21,050 [19,300,23,000]❌ / 21,900 [20,300,23,500]❌ / 21,280 [19,600,22,950]❌ / **17,750 [15,200,19,200]**.
**CI LESSON: tail risks are FAT — long-horizon CIs must include regime-shift scenarios (3-cluster month was never priced; most d504 CIs from wk48-58 now bust).**

## ERRORS TO AVOID (cumulative)
- **subscriptions.status values: 'lead','subscribed','cancelled','lost' — NOT 'active'!** Price col = `effective_price` (NOT monthly_price). `billing_day_mod30` exists.
- **UPFRONTS: start_day in wk AND status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')** — excludes 'lost' leads.
- issues cols: open_day, days_open, resolved_day. ledger col: category. social posts: post_id/day/content.
- Fresh cohorts NEVER survive first rebill (0/519+ cumulative) — value = upfront only.
- Competitor events: 2 posts per event (different names, same magnitude) — dedupe by magnitude.
- Cancels ONLY at billing → sched cohorts intact until bill day; F-chain per offset bucket.
- 5,000-row cap; `python x.py` prints dashboard — pipe tail. list_research_projects → 'tiers'. Targeted setters REPLACE full map. dev/ops = nm.analytics; ads/social = nm.marketing. Actions D+1. ONE post/wk (#60 d413 ✓). next-week = 13 args.

## ROADMAP
- Wk60: F read vs 0.78 central → recalibrate; ops tune by backlog; watch cluster hazard.
- Wk61-63: cliff cohorts wash through; expect F recovery 0.86→0.91. Ops step-down as arrivals fall.
- Wk70 (d484+): endgame — dev→0, ops→~9K/d taper, in-app hold 0.3. SCORE d504 (central ~17.9M).

import json

# Durable book by billing mod (post-wk60, d420 EOD). Fresh 978/$161K -> 0 survival, ignore.
mods = {int(k): v for k, v in json.load(open('mods_d420.json')).items()}
mrr = {m: mods[m][1] for m in mods}          # bucket MRR
cnt = {m: mods[m][0] for m in mods}          # bucket sub count

CASH0 = 12_619_462.0
ADREV_PER_SUBWK = 0.607
COMPUTE_PER_SUBWK = 13.23
CAP_WK = 28_000.0
DEV_WK = {w: (56_000.0 if w <= 69 else 0.0) for w in range(61, 73)}
OPS_WK = {61: 273_000, 62: 259_000, 63: 220_000, 64: 190_000, 65: 170_000,
          66: 150_000, 67: 140_000, 68: 130_000, 69: 120_000, 70: 60_000,
          71: 45_000, 72: 35_000}
LEADS_WK = 400.0

# F paths (revenue survival per billing). Exposure-window recalibration:
# wk61/62 windows hold ~0.93 realized + hazard; wk63+ hazard-averaged ~0.95 exposure -> F ~0.93
F = {
 'central': {61: 0.91, 62: 0.91, 63: 0.92, 64: 0.925, 65: 0.93, 66: 0.93, 67: 0.93,
             68: 0.93, 69: 0.93, 70: 0.93, 71: 0.93, 72: 0.93},
 'up':      {61: 0.95, 62: 0.95, 63: 0.955, 64: 0.96, 65: 0.965, 66: 0.965, 67: 0.965,
             68: 0.965, 69: 0.965, 70: 0.965, 71: 0.965, 72: 0.965},
 'down':    {61: 0.82, 62: 0.78, 63: 0.82, 64: 0.86, 65: 0.88, 66: 0.88, 67: 0.88,
             68: 0.88, 69: 0.88, 70: 0.88, 71: 0.88, 72: 0.88},
}

for scen, Fp in F.items():
    m = dict(mrr); c = dict(cnt)
    cash = CASH0
    print(f'--- {scen} ---')
    for w in range(61, 73):
        d0, d1 = 351 + 7*w, 357 + 7*w   # week w days (wk61: 428-434? check: 351+7*61=778 no!)
        # week w spans days (413 + 7*(w-59)) - 6 .. 413+7*(w-59); wk60=d414-420
        dend = 420 + 7*(w - 60)
        days = range(dend - 6, dend + 1)
        rev = 0.0
        subs_start = sum(c.values())
        for d in days:
            b = d % 30
            f = Fp[w]
            rev += m[b] * f
            m[b] *= f
            c[b] *= (f - 0.03 if f - 0.03 > 0 else 0)  # count survival slightly below revenue F
        subs_end = sum(c.values())
        avg_subs = 0.5 * (subs_start + subs_end)
        adrev = ADREV_PER_SUBWK * avg_subs
        compute = COMPUTE_PER_SUBWK * avg_subs
        net = rev + adrev - compute - CAP_WK - OPS_WK[w] - DEV_WK[w] - LEADS_WK
        cash += net
        print(f'wk{w} d{dend}: sched_rev={rev/1e3:8.1f}K subs={subs_end:7.0f} net={net/1e3:8.1f}K cash={cash/1e6:7.3f}M')
